restoration_note: A bipartite map: four chosen ways drawn from the Zone reckoned to the Light (ascending through the ships to life), parallel to a company of mingled and Error-bound ways that pour into Gehenna. The descending paths are enumerated as four works against the Cross of Light (ⲡⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ): lawlessness (ⲁⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ), killing/separating-of-body (ⲡⲱⲣⲝ̄), wounding word (ⲡⲥⲉⲭⲉ ⲉⲧϯⲁⲥⲉ), and blasphemy (ⲡⲭⲓⲟⲩⲁ). Most fills are tightly constrained by the formulaic enumeration ('the second is the X', 'the third is the Y'), by directional pairs (ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ / ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ), and by Greek-loan reconstructions split across line breaks (ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗ-ⲓ-ⲥⲙⲟⲥ, ⲁⲛⲟ-ⲙⲓⲁ). Editor proposals largely held; I adjusted {11} to ⲡⲱⲣⲝ̄ on the basis of the partial trace ⲡ̄...ⲝ̄ in 4 characters and the gloss 'killing' (cutting-off-of-body). Confidence is high where editor's traces or formula bind tightly; moderate where the verb-of-striking ({13}) has multiple Lycopolitan candidates.

restorations.basis: preposition ⲁ- 'to' merging with article of ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ; completes 'reckoned to the light' from previous line; ascending arc to ⲡⲱⲛⲍ̄ 'life'
Lycopolitan qualitative of ⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ̄ 'mingle' (lexicon: Mingling = light bound in darkness); fits the eight ways from which the light is rescued upward — the mingled state to be sorted
completes ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'upward' (lexicon: ⲃⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ = ascend); follows ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ ⲃⲱⲕ 'the light is wont to go' — light's ascent through the ships
directional ⲁ- + plural article ⲛⲉ before ⲭⲏⲩ 'ships' (lexicon: ship = doctrinal vessel / luminary as ascent-vessel); the rescued light goes within unto the ships
Lycopolitan directional ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ (lexicon entry under 'descend'); inverse pole of ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ above; required by Error being 'cast down' into transmutation
middle vowel of Greek loanword μετάλλισμος / ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ (lexicon: metensomatosis); split across line break ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗ-ⲓ-ⲥⲙⲟⲥ
previous line ends ⲡ̄- (article of ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ wrapping); ⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ = Error (lexicon); plural relative converter ⲛⲉⲧ- before ϣⲟⲩⲟ̄ (3pl 'pour forth'), referring to 'the other three ways'

completes a preceding declarative ('you have made known forth, that...') introducing the summary count; ⲡϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲓⲧ 'the three ways' is required by the immediately following 'reckoned to the Error are those that draw down to Gehenna'
circumstantial ⲉⲩ- + qualitative ⲥⲏⲕ 'be drawn'; resumes the ⲥⲏⲕ ⲁⲛⲅⲉⲉⲛⲛⲁ verb from previous line — 'they being drawn through all flesh'
ⲡⲟⲩⲉ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ 'one of them' is the standard Coptic enumerative idiom inaugurating the list ('the second is...', 'the third is...' follows)
Greek loanword ἀνομία 'lawlessness' split across line break: ⲛ̄ⲧ-ⲁⲛⲟ-ⲙⲓⲁ; matches the reading's 'abundance of lawlessness — unbridled outflow of the proprium'

partial trace ⲡ̄...ⲝ̄ in 4 chars; ⲡⲱⲣⲝ̄ 'separation/cutting-off' (lexicon: ⲡⲱⲣⲭ = separate forth, here glossed by following ⲡϩⲱⲧⲃⲉ 'killing' — the cutting-off of every body = murder, the second descending work
3 chars; previous line ends ⲙ̄- (object marker prefix); ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϥ 'it' (3sg.m, anaphoric to ⲡϩⲱⲧⲃⲉ 'the killing') split across line break — 'that which they multiply IT in all flesh'

4 chars; relative clause ⲡⲉⲧ-[verb]-ⲙ̄ⲡⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ 'that which smites the cross'; Lycopolitan ⲣⲁⲍⲧ̄ 'strike/smite' fits the apparatus 'verb of striking/wounding' and the wounding-word arc against the Cross of Light
editor's trace -ⲉⲡⲉ; ⲡⲕⲉ-ⲥⲉⲡⲉ 'the remainder/rest' — the residue of Error's works alongside the blasphemy, completing the fourfold enumeration of descending paths
editor's trace ⲡⲭ-; ⲭⲓⲟⲩⲁ (Sahidic ϫⲓⲟⲩⲁ) 'blasphemy' pairs with ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ as cosmic principle; matches reading's 'mockery of the gods — the heavenly intelligences themselves mocked by cosmic Error'
